channel.title: The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from all 55 African countries, every source cited.

item.title: Sierra Leone vice presidents lack succession path
item.description: No vice president has ever been elected president, raising questions about the current officeholder's future.

item.title: Sierra Leone charcoal burning causes deforestation

item.title: Equatorial Guinea to host continental campaign against HIV/AIDS
item.description: The event from December 14-17 will focus on strengthening women's and girls' resilience to climate change and conflict.

item.title: Afreximbank targets over $540m deals at Lagos CANEX
item.description: The African Export-Import Bank aims to finance African music, film, and fashion businesses.
